build_disjoint_linear_bandit: build a DisjointLinearBandit with separate linear regressions for each discrete action in the action space
learn_batch_disjoint_linear_bandit: train each action-specific linear regression on filtered transitions from a TransitionBatch by action index
act_disjoint_linear_bandit: select an action using ensemble forward pass over per-action linear regressions and an exploration module
set_history_summarization_module_disjoin: assign a HistorySummarizationModule to the DisjointLinearBandit without adding parameters to a PyTorch optimizer
compare_disjoint_linear_bandit: compare two DisjointLinearBandit instances for differences in attributes and per-action linear regression weights
